description: Titles that open with a number. A section number is not a figure: "1 Introduction", "1.2 Requirements" and "2. Installation" are likely. A short title that opens with a number and could be a statistic ("3D rendering options", "2026 roadmap", "15 years") is info with the flag statistic, and a word in the style of prices is info with the flag peersNumeric: both are left to a judgement (adjudicate is true, see the unit tests). Such titles do not make the numbered ones in their style numbers by association. Only text that is mostly digits or carries a currency or percent sign is a number for good (flag numeric).
